summary: Verified reciprocal negative-constraint additions in _tag_character (ai_chat.py) via runtime + E2E tests. 5/5 pass. Both tinkerpug and bullpug branches emit the required substrings after string concatenation; the generic (else) branch remains unmodified. context_for_next_testing_agent: test_ai_chat_negative_constraints.py imports _tag_character directly and validates runtime output — 3 source-code tests (tinkerpug substrings, bullpug substrings, else branch unmodified) + 2 E2E tests via /api/ai/chat. Use pattern of importing helpers directly rather than regex-scanning source when strings span multiple adjacent literals.
